$note: Single tokens file for the Hợp nhất design. Semantic colour tokens exist once per mode (dark, light) with identical names, so SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose can load the same file. Colours are hex (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).

shared.layout: A - Lá chắn: status hero, blocked list, primary button docked at the bottom
shared.stateRule: Protection state is always an icon plus words. Green and red are never the only signal.

roles.bg / bgTop: Screen background; bgTop is the top of the vertical gradient behind the shield
roles.surface / sheet / field: List card, bottom sheet, input fill
roles.accent / onAccent: Primary button fill and its label
roles.protected / protectedText: Shield and rings when protection is on; the same hue tuned for text
roles.danger / onDanger / dangerText: Shield, Bật ngay and Bỏ chặn fills when off or destructive; label on that fill; the hue tuned for text
roles.warnText: Validation messages in the add sheet
roles.glowOn / glowOff / shadow: Shield glow per state; card and sheet shadow

platform.shared: All colour tokens for both modes, radii, sizes, durations, spring values and the order of each interaction.
platform.ios: Load both palettes into an asset catalog or a Color extension keyed by colorScheme. SF Pro Rounded is built in. Haptics: sensoryFeedback on iOS 17+, UIImpactFeedbackGenerator on iOS 16. On iOS 26 the sheet and toolbar pick up system Liquid Glass; keep the list card and shield opaque.
platform.android: Map both palettes to a Compose ColorScheme chosen by isSystemInDarkTheme() and turn dynamic colour off so the green and red stay fixed. Bundle a rounded font. Compose spring() takes stiffness and dampingRatio, so convert the spring values. Haptic strength varies by device.
platform.difference: The 8-digit hex values with alpha are #RRGGBBAA; Android Color(0x...) expects AARRGGBB, so reorder when parsing.
